name: River Development Agent Controlled Execution Seal Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED EXECUTION SEAL FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-286 consumes only the exact DEV-285 controlled execution certification result contract.
DEV-286 denies sealing when the DEV-285 predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, uncertified, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required certification evidence.
DEV-286 creates deterministic seal data only.
DEV-286 does not execute or re-execute an operation.
DEV-286 does not retry execution.
DEV-286 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-286 does not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-286 preserves the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-286 preserves predecessor provenance and the complete execution/certification evidence chain.
DEV-286 does not expand execution scope.
DEV-286 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-286 does not modify repository content.
DEV-286 does not delete repository content.
DEV-286 does not stage repository changes.
DEV-286 does not commit.
DEV-286 does not push.
DEV-286 does not deploy.
DEV-286 does not access secrets.
DEV-286 does not perform arbitrary shell execution.
DEV-286 does not perform network execution.
DEV-286 does not perform external side effects.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
A future explicit controlled execution integrity boundary is required before downstream progression.
